title: testRepository2
summary: A small personal Python project containing scripts (createSynthesizer.py, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer.py, validate.py) that load local CSV data, define table metadata, and generate synthetic tabular data. It directly instantiates and runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, validating metadata and evaluating quality via SDV's evaluation module.
needs: No README present; repository appears to be a personal test/learning project (6 commits, single contributor) rather than a distributed tool.
